body.summary: Completed the physical self-hosting proof. Bonfÿre imported and materially consumed the external challenge, projected it through EventGraph and WorkGraph, selected and delivered a Codex-authored challenge to Claude through ProviderGraph without Nick relaying text, and received Claude's independently generated 14/14 replay proof.
